stories.title: Un suspect de 14 ans, un principal et une professeure blessés... Ce que l'on sait des tirs par arme à feu dans un collège d'Aubagne

en.title: 14-year-old suspect, principal and teacher wounded... What we know about the shooting at a middle school in Aubagne
en.summary: A 14-year-old student opened fire at a middle school in Aubagne, wounding the principal and a teacher. The suspect was quickly arrested and interior and education ministers visited the scene.

stories.title: Aubagne : Edouard Geffray dénonce un « acte criminel » après qu’un élève a tiré sur le principal et une professeure de son collège

en.title: Aubagne: Edouard Geffray denounces a "criminal act" after a student shoots at the principal and a teacher of his middle school
en.summary: A middle school student fired on the principal and a teacher at his school in Aubagne, injuring both in the lower limbs. The suspect was arrested and the two victims were hospitalized.

stories.title: A Paris, l'emblématique marché des Enfants rouges a été "totalement détruit" par un incendie

en.title: In Paris, the emblematic Enfants Rouges market was "totally destroyed" by a fire
en.summary: A fire completely destroyed the historic Enfants Rouges market in Paris, a landmark founded in 1615 and designated a protected monument since 1982. The Paris mayor announced the city will support affected merchants and residents.

stories.title: Un élève ouvre le feu dans un collège d'Aubagne, le proviseur et une enseignante blessés

en.title: A student opens fire at a middle school in Aubagne, the principal and a teacher wounded
en.summary: A 14-year-old student fired a shotgun at Joseph-Lakanal middle school in Aubagne, wounding the principal and a teacher. The Marseille prosecutor opened an investigation for attempted murder charges.

stories.title: Principal d’un collège et une enseignante blessés à l’arme à feu à Aubagne : les réactions des politiques

en.title: Principal of a middle school and a teacher wounded by gunfire in Aubagne: political reactions
en.summary: A 14-year-old student opened fire with a shotgun at his middle school in Aubagne on Monday morning, injuring the principal and a teacher before being disarmed by staff. The incident appears unrelated to ongoing student protests.

stories.title: Bouches-du-Rhône : le principal d’un collège et une enseignante blessés à l’arme à feu à Aubagne

en.title: Bouches-du-Rhône: principal of a middle school and a teacher wounded by gunfire in Aubagne
en.summary: Two school officials were struck by 12-caliber bullets in front of their middle school in Aubagne. A 14-year-old student suspected of firing multiple shots was arrested immediately afterward.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : Volodymyr Zelensky signale la poursuite des frappes russes malgré le cessez-le-feu énergétique annoncé par Donald Trump

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: Volodymyr Zelensky reports continued Russian strikes despite energy ceasefire announced by Donald Trump
en.summary: Ukraine did not target any Russian energy infrastructure overnight following Donald Trump's announcement of an energy sector ceasefire, according to the Ukrainian president on Monday.

stories.title: Aubagne : un principal et une enseignante de collège blessés par des tirs au fusil de chasse, un adolescent arrêté

en.title: Aubagne: middle school principal and teacher wounded by shotgun fire, teenager arrested
en.summary: A 14-year-old was arrested Monday following gunfire at Lakanal middle school that injured a principal and teacher. The Marseille prosecutor's office launched an investigation into attempted murder charges.

stories.title: Une cyberattaque a touché les infrastructures frigorifiques de centaines de supermarchés Coopérative U, Intermarché et E.Leclerc

en.title: A cyberattack struck the refrigeration infrastructure of hundreds of supermarkets Coopérative U, Intermarché and E.Leclerc
en.summary: A cyberattack targeted Danfoss, Danish software managing refrigeration systems for major French retailers. The Groupement Mousquetaires estimates losses at several million euros.

stories.title: Plusieurs centaines de supermarchés Intermarché et Coopérative U victimes d’une cyberattaque visant leurs installations frigorifiques

en.title: Several hundred Intermarché and Coopérative U supermarkets victims of a cyberattack targeting their refrigeration installations
en.summary: Hundreds of stores were forced to discard all fresh and frozen products due to a cyberattack affecting refrigeration systems at Intermarché and Coopérative U.

stories.title: France : le marché parisien des Enfants rouges détruit par une incendie

en.title: France: the Parisian market of Enfants rouges destroyed by fire
en.summary: A fire completely destroyed the historic Enfants rouges market in Paris's 3rd arrondissement overnight Sunday to Monday. Founded in 1615, no casualties occurred and neighboring buildings were unaffected.

stories.title: Le marché des Enfants-Rouges, à Paris, « totalement détruit » après un incendie

en.title: The Enfants-Rouges market in Paris "completely destroyed" after a fire
en.summary: A fire has left the Enfants-Rouges market in Paris's 3rd arrondissement completely destroyed, though the blaze was brought under control and caused no injuries.

stories.title: Flying Whales lève enfin 90 millions d’euros pour financer ses dirigeables XXL

en.title: Flying Whales raises 90 million euros to finance its XXL airships
en.summary: Flying Whales completed a funding round of 90 million euros after two years of negotiations, with French strategic investors joining existing shareholders. The funding secures the company until its XXL airship's first flight scheduled for late 2028 in Gironde.

stories.title: Accident d’un avion Elixir : la perte d’un volet gauche à l’origine

en.title: Elixir aircraft accident: loss of left flap at origin
en.summary: Two employees of French company Elixir Aircraft died in an accident involving one of the company's two-seat aircraft on October 1st. French aviation authorities concluded that detachment of the left flap during a turn caused the crash.

stories.title: ▶️Industrie du tourisme : le premium confirmé comme levier d’attractivité

en.title: Tourism industry: premium segment confirmed as attractiveness lever
en.summary: A program discussing tourism industry trends highlights the premium segment as a key factor in attracting visitors and economic growth.

stories.title: Lockheed Martin : entre productivité et nouvelle génération pour le Patriot

en.title: Lockheed Martin: between productivity and new generation for Patriot
en.summary: Lockheed Martin, the prime contractor for the Patriot interceptor missile, unveiled the new PAC-3 Edge generation on October 9th. The upgraded system will be more performant than the current PAC-3, with focus on production and export needs.

stories.title: « Le pôle Aerospace Valley génère un énorme effet de levier industriel » (Nicolas Granier, président)

en.title: "Aerospace Valley cluster generates enormous industrial leverage" (Nicolas Granier, president)
en.summary: Nicolas Granier takes over leadership of Europe's leading aerospace competitiveness cluster with new governance. The aerospace sector faces multiple challenges including increased aircraft production rates, supporting light aviation actors, and growing drone sector development.
